title: mob balls
description: This mod adds balls that can catch mobs with different tiers. More tier = More better (I know how grammar works! It just rhymes better)
body:
## This mod adds balls that can catch mobs
It has different tiers, the more expensive the tier, the better chance of catching it. Some really high tiers even have special features like having a chance to get 2 of it from catching it once or a chance of getting it, but not capturing it.
### This mod also adds new structures
It adds an old-timey small vilage with <details>Loot like balls, cores, and even super secret hidden loot(sorry, you'll have to find out)<summary>Secrets</summary></details>
